about.title: Built for India's used industrial machinery trade
about.description: BIM is a B2B marketplace connecting verified sellers of used industrial machinery with serious buyers across India — backed by proof-based listings, anonymised communication and optional certification and financing.
about.paragraph1: The market for used industrial machinery in India has long run on word-of-mouth, unverifiable listings and direct deals that leave both sides exposed. BIM was built to change that — bringing GST verification, proof-backed listings and transparent commission economics to a trade that deserves better infrastructure.
about.paragraph2: Whether you are a manufacturer looking to liquidate equipment, a trader sourcing machines for resale, or a growing business buying your first CNC lathe or compressor, BIM gives you the tools to transact with confidence: verified counterparties, certified machines when financing is involved, and a chat system that keeps you safe until a deal is genuinely ready to close.

verificationFirst.title: Verification first
verificationFirst.body: Every seller on BIM is GST-verified before they can publish a listing. We believe trust on a B2B marketplace starts with knowing exactly who you are dealing with.

proofNotPromises.title: Proof, not promises
proofNotPromises.body: Listings require timestamped photos and a running video showing the machine in operation — so buyers can judge condition for themselves, not just take a seller's word.

privacyUntilItCounts.title: Privacy until it counts
privacyUntilItCounts.body: We keep both sides anonymous through admin-mediated chat until a deal is real and commission is settled — protecting the marketplace and everyone in it.

fairSimpleEconomics.title: Fair, simple economics
fairSimpleEconomics.body: A flat 1% + 1% commission on the agreed sale price. No hidden listing fees, no surprises — just a transparent cost shared between buyer and seller.

cta.body: Create a free account, verify your details, and start trading on a marketplace built around trust and transparency.

howItWorks.title: A transparent, proof-backed process for both sides of the trade
howItWorks.description: From GST verification to commission-gated contact release, every step is designed to protect buyers, sellers and the integrity of the marketplace.

verifyGst.title: Verify your GST
verifyGst.body: Sellers must hold an ACTIVE GST registration, validated through the Masters India API. Your legal business name is auto-filled from the verification response.

buildListing.title: Build your listing
buildListing.body: Add machine details — category, make, model, year, asking price and location — and choose a complexity tier (this drives certification fees later).

uploadProofMedia.title: Upload proof media
uploadProofMedia.body: Every listing needs 5–10 timestamped photos (captured within the last 30 days) plus exactly one running video of at least 60 seconds showing the machine actively operating with a timestamp overlay. We recommend the Timestamp Camera app for this.

submitForReview.title: Submit for review
submitForReview.body: Your listing moves to Pending review. Our admin team checks the media and details before approving it to go live as Active.

receiveBuyerEnquiries.title: Receive buyer enquiries
receiveBuyerEnquiries.body: Interested buyers submit an enquiry through BIM. You see their name and location — no direct contact details until commission is settled, keeping the deal inside the platform.

settleCommission.title: Settle commission, get paid
settleCommission.body: When a sale is agreed, a transaction records the price with a 1% buyer commission and 1% seller commission. Once that commission is marked paid, contact details are released to both sides so the handover can proceed directly.

browseWithoutBarriers.title: Browse without barriers
browseWithoutBarriers.body: Search and filter listings by category, make, year, price and location — no account or GST required just to look.

sendEnquiry.title: Send an enquiry
sendEnquiry.body: Sign up, verify your phone via OTP, and send an enquiry on any listing. The seller sees your name and location; BIM's admin team reviews every enquiry before connecting both parties.

verifyGstForFinancing.title: Verify GST for financing
verifyGstForFinancing.body: Browsing and enquiring never require GST. But if you want to apply for a loan against a purchase, your GST must first be verified as ACTIVE.

applyForFinancing.title: Apply for financing
applyForFinancing.body: Submit a loan application against a listing. Our admin team reviews eligibility after certification completes and routes your application to the best-fit bank or NBFC.

certificationForPeaceOfMind.title: Certification for peace of mind
certificationForPeaceOfMind.body: Our inspectors assess the machine—fees vary by complexity tier (Simple, Standard, Complex)—and produce a report you and the finance partner can rely on.

payCommissionGetContact.title: Pay commission, get contact details
payCommissionGetContact.body: Once you and the seller agree a price and the commission is settled, both parties receive each other's direct contact information to complete the deal.

buyback.title: Buyback & depreciation
buyback.body: Sellers can request a buyback quote at any time. We compute a depreciated value from our category-specific depreciation schedule based on the machine's age, then offer a buyback amount as a percentage of that depreciated value — a fast, transparent way to exit a machine without waiting for a buyer.
